scope: One run per renderer, automatic updates, deterministic animated 3D scene, RTX 5080 development machine, 1920x1080; not a timing-budget certification or isolated UI overhead.
limitations: API CPU excludes deferred automatic updates.
core_cpu is sampled before the next process frame and is not aligned to the current changed frame.
Whole-frame and viewport renderer metrics include the shared scene. Differences of run percentiles are not isolated causal UI cost.
No lower-end hardware or indefinite memory claim.
